ドロドロの体液にまみれた自分を見て、一度だけ大き\r\nな悲鳴を上げたあと、床に: Upon seeing herself covered in viscous fluid, she let out one loud scream, then crumpled to the floor and began to weep.
小娘の足元には、処女だった証が点々と残ってい\r\nる……。\r\n: At the girl's feet, scattered proof of her lost virginity remained......
ソファーに横になっていると、あくびが出てきた。\r\n: Lying on the sofa, I let out a yawn.
見世物としてはそれなりに楽しめたが、そろそろ体の\r\nほうがついて来ない。\r: It had been entertaining enough as a spectacle, but my body was starting to give out.
何しろあれだけ派手な戦闘を行った後だ。\r\n: After all, I had just been through one hell of a fight.
体のあちこちは痛むし、眠気もピークに達しようとし\r\nていた。\r\n: My body ached all over, and the drowsiness was reaching its peak.
すすり泣く小娘がうるさかったが、泣き止ませるのも\r\n面倒だ。\r\n: The sobbing girl was annoying, but making her stop was too much trouble.
オレはまぶたを閉じると、そのまま深い眠りへと落ち\r\nていった……。\r\n: I closed my eyes and sank straight into a deep sleep......
朝の寝覚めは最悪だった。\r\n: Waking up that morning was the worst.
体のあちこちが痛み、その刺激で目が覚めた。\r\n: Pain all over my body -- that was what jolted me awake.
おそらくは寝返りでも打ったのだろうが、それさえも\r\n満足にできない自分に、朝: I had probably just rolled over in my sleep, but the fact that even that was beyond me had me irritated first thing in the morning.
刹那、脳裏にあの女の顔が浮かび、憎悪が炎のように\r\n湧き上がった。\r\n: In an instant, that woman's face surfaced in my mind, and hatred flared up inside me like a flame.
煉悟\r\n「次に会ったときは、必ずとっ捕まえて犯しまくって\r\n やらァ！」:
Rengo
"Next time I see her, I'll catch her for sure and fuck her senseless!"
ギリッと歯軋りしながら、なるべく体に負担を掛けな\r\nいようにしてソファーから: Grinding my teeth, I pushed myself up from the sofa as carefully as I could to avoid straining my body.
――と、足元にぐにゃりとした感触。\r\n: ----And then, a soft, squishy sensation underfoot.
ふと視線を落とせば、床に見覚えのない『もの』が\r\n転がっていた。\r\n:
Glancing down, I noticed an unfamiliar 'thing' lying
on the floor.
自分の体をぎゅっと抱き締めるようにして、ガタガタ\r\nと震えている。\r\n:
It was hugging itself tight, trembling
uncontrollably.
そういえば、蟲の産卵用に連れ帰ってきた小娘だった\r\nな……。\r\n:
Right -- it was the little girl I'd brought back as a
laying host for the Bugs...
卵が孵るまでは暫く時間が掛かるだろうから、それま\r\nで隣の部屋にでも放り込ん:
It would take some time for the eggs to hatch, so I'd
just toss her in the next room until then.
小娘の体をベッドに放り投げると、大量の埃が舞った。\r\n:
When I threw the girl onto the bed, a cloud of
dust billowed up.
そういえば、ロクに掃除などした事はなかったはずだ。\r\n:
Come to think of it, I'd never really bothered to clean
the place.
まあ、用途を考えれば、別にどれだけ汚れてようと\r\n構わないんだが……。\r\:
Well, given what the room was used for, it didn't matter
how filthy it got...
部屋のあちこちには、薄汚れたシミが付着していた。\r\n: Dingy stains clung to every corner of the room.
それは、血、汗、体液、さらには排泄物などが混ざり\r\n合い出来上がったものだ。:
They were a blend of blood, sweat, bodily fluids, and
even excrement, all mixed together.
今まで何人もの女がここで蟲を産んでは、発狂、或い\r\nは死という形をもって役目:
Countless women had birthed Bugs here, then met their end
in madness or death...
暫くぼんやりと天井を見つめたあと、少しずつ意識を\r\n覚醒させていった。\r\:
She stared blankly at the ceiling for a moment, then
slowly began to regain her senses.
人がいると思ってなかったのか、小娘が大慌てでベッ\r\nドから起き上がった。\r:
She must not have expected anyone to be there -- the girl
scrambled up off the bed in a panic.
オレの顔を見るなり後ずさりして、体を壁際へと寄せ\r\nていく。\r\n:
The moment she saw my face, she backed away, pressing
herself against the wall.
煉悟\r\n「ハッ、分っかりやすい反応してくれるぜ」\r\n:
Rengo
"Ha -- you sure make it easy to read you."
だいぶ混乱してるらしく、オレを見たり部屋を見たり\r\n自分を見たりと忙しい。\:
She seemed thoroughly confused, her eyes darting between
me, the room, and herself.
だが、それで事態を理解できるはずもなく、唯一自分\r\nが異常な状況にあることだ:
But there was no way she could make sense of the situation
from that -- all she seemed to grasp was that something was terribly wrong.
恐怖で声も出ないのか、小娘が真っ青な顔になって\r\nガタガタと震える。\r\n:
Too paralyzed with fear to make a sound, the girl's face
had gone dead white as she shook uncontrollably.
まぶたは眼球が零れそうなほどに見開かれ、額には\r\nびっしりと汗の粒ができてい:
Her eyelids were stretched so wide her eyes looked ready
to fall out, and beads of sweat covered her forehead.
煉悟\r\n「いいぜぇ。大人しいのは面倒がなくていい」\r\n:
Rengo
"Good. Quiet ones are less trouble."
煉悟\r\n「あとは、苗床としてしっかり蟲どもを産むんだな」\r\n:
Rengo
"Now just make sure you do your job and birth those Bugs
as a proper Seedbed."
高笑いしながら、部屋を後にする。\r\n: I left the room, laughing out loud.
説明など一切しないし、する必要もない。\r\n:
I had no intention of explaining anything -- nor any
need to.
あの小娘は単なる苗床で、それ以上でもそれ以下でも\r\nないからだ。\r\n:
That girl was nothing more than a Seedbed -- no more,
no less.
あれは――ただの道具だ――――。\r\n: She was -- nothing but a tool--------.
昼になるより少し前になって、街のほうへと足を運ん\r\nだ。\r\n: A little before noon, I made my way into town.
本当は大人しく身を隠すべきなんだろうが、あいにく\r\n食料がスッカラカンの状態:
I probably should have stayed low and kept out of sight,
but unfortunately my food supply was bone dry.
蟲使い、裏社会の人間とはいえ、やはり食わなくては\r\n生きていけない。\r\n:
Bug User, underworld dweller -- even so, a man still
needed to eat to survive.
普段は、一週間分の食料で済ますのだが、今回は念の\r\nため二週間分買い込む事に:
Normally I'd buy enough to last a week, but this time
I decided to stock up for two weeks just to be safe.
何しろこういった生活だ。\r\nいつも買い物に出られるとは限らない。\r\n:
Living the way I did, there was no guarantee I could
always get out to go shopping.
正直、自分以外に動ける奴がいると楽なんだが……。\r\n:
Honestly, it'd make life easier to have someone besides me
who could run errands...
煉悟\r\n「クヒッ、あの小娘でも調教するかァ？」\r\n:
Rengo
"Khih -- maybe I'll train that little girl to do it?"
どうせ、今は蟲を産む以外に使い道のない奴だ。\r\n:
Right now she was useless for anything other than
birthing Bugs anyway.
気分が乗れば、奴隷にするのもいいかもしれない。\r\n:
If I felt like it, making her a slave might not be
a bad idea.
煉悟\r\n「ん……そういや、ここだったな」\r\n:
Rengo
"Hn... come to think of it, this was the place."
街を歩いている途中、昨日女と闘り合った場所へやっ\r\nて来ていた。\r\n:
Walking through town, I had wandered back to the spot
where I'd fought the woman yesterday.
道路にはちょいとした人だかりができ、黒ずんだアス\r\nファルトに目を向けている:
A small crowd had gathered on the road, all eyes fixed
on the blackened asphalt.
自動車は撤去されたようだが、辺りにはまだガラスの\r\n破片などが散らばっている:
The car had apparently been removed, but shards of glass
and other debris were still scattered around.
朝のニュースでは、そんな風に報道されているのだろ\r\nうか。\r\n: Was that how the morning news had reported it?
隠れ家にはテレビがないので分からないが、いちいち\r\n確認してそれを知ろうとも:
There was no TV at the hideout, so I had no way of
knowing -- and I had no desire to bother finding out.
例え事実がどうであっても、あの家族、そしてあの\r\n小娘が不運だった事に変わり:
Whatever the truth of the matter, the fact remained that
that family -- and that girl -- had been unlucky.
それよりも、当面の問題はあの蟲使いの女だ。\r\n: More pressing than that, though, was the immediate problem of that Bug User woman.
オレ自身の力量も、蟲の強さも、今のままでは敵わな\r\nい。\r\n: My own strength, the power of my Bugs -- neither was a match for her as things stood.
ましてや、敵があの女一人かどうかさえ分からない今、\r\nオレにできる事は、少し: What's more, I didn't even know if she was the only enemy I was up against. About all I could do was build up as many powerful Bugs as possible.
煉悟\r\n「さぁて、これからどうしたもんか」\r\n:
Rengo
"So then... what's the plan from here?"
幸いにして倉庫には数匹の蟲を残していたが、言い換\r\nえればそれが全ての戦力と: Fortunately, I had left a few Bugs back at the warehouse -- but in other words, those were my entire fighting force.
オレの体ひとつでどうにかなる相手ならともかく、\r\n蟲使いが相手となればやはり: If she were the kind of opponent I could handle with my body alone, that would be one thing -- but against a Bug User, I needed Bugs.
果たして、手持ちの蟲をどう使うべきか……。\r\n: The question was how to best use the Bugs I had on hand...
煉悟\r\n「仕掛けてみる、か？」\r\n:
Rengo
"Should I try making a move?"
相手はオレを殺したと思っているかもしれない。\r\n: She might think she'd already killed me.
そこを衝けば、勝機が見えてくるかもしれなかった。\r\n: If I could exploit that, a chance at victory might open up.
もっとも、あの女がどこにいるのか分からないのだか\r\nら、攻撃する事など不可能: Of course, since I had no idea where that woman was, actually launching an attack was out of the question...
煉悟\r\n「餌の時間が同じなら、可能性はあるな」\r\n:
Rengo
"If she feeds at the same time I do, there's a chance."
蟲を飼っている以上、どこかで餌を与えなければなら\r\nない。\r\n: As long as you keep Bugs, you have to feed them somewhere.
ドッグフードみたいなもんがあって屋内で食わせてる\r\nならアウトだが、もしもオ: If she had some kind of dog food equivalent and was feeding them indoors, I was out of luck -- but if she used the same method I did and let them loose...
煉悟\r\n「どうせこっちも餌は食わさなきゃならねぇしな。\r\n 見つけた端か:
Rengo
"Either way, I've got to feed mine too.
 Might as well have them attack hers on sight."
可能性としてはあまり高くないが、やってみる価値が\r\nないわけでもない。\r\: The odds weren't particularly high, but that didn't mean it wasn't worth trying.
要するに餌を取ってる間に敵に出くわせば、片っ端か\r\nらぶっ潰せと命令を下して: In short, all I had to do was give the order: if you run into an enemy Bug while you're out feeding, crush it on the spot.
煉悟\r\n「よぅし、そうと決まれば早速試してみるか」\r\n:
Rengo
"Alright, now that that's settled, let's give it a shot."
煉悟\r\n「面倒だ。ここで放してみるか」\r\n:
Rengo
"Too much trouble. Maybe I'll just let them loose here."
普通に考えれば、餌の多い森や川辺で放すほうが自然\r\nだ。\r\n: Common sense said it was more natural to release them in a forest or riverbank where prey was plentiful.
だが、可能性がゼロではない以上、試してみるのも\r\n悪くないだろう。\r\n: But as long as the possibility wasn't zero, trying it out couldn't hurt.
ゆっくりと街を歩きながら、一匹ずつ蟲を解き放って\r\nいく。\r\n: Walking slowly through town, I released the Bugs one by one.
もちろん、そのへんをボーッと歩いてる連中に気付か\r\nれるようなヘマはしない。: Of course, I wasn't careless enough to let the people wandering around notice.
オレの足元を注意して見てる奴がいれば話は別だが、\r\nそれなりに混雑している人: If someone happened to be watching my feet closely, that would be another matter -- but in a crowd this size, nobody would be idle enough to do something that odd.
適度に間隔を開けて、蟲を街中に放していく。\r\n: At measured intervals, I released the Bugs throughout the town.
果たして、この辺りに奴の蟲はいるのか、それとも\r\n全く別の場所で悠々と餌を食: Were any of her Bugs lurking around here, or were they off somewhere else, feeding at their leisure?
あまり期待はせずに、オレは蟲どもの帰りを待つこと\r\nにした……。\r\n: Without expecting too much, I decided to wait for my Bugs to return...
煉悟\r\n「ま、予想通りってヤツか」\r\n:
Rengo
"Well, just about what I expected."
戻ってきた蟲どもを回収して、オレは短く嘆息した。\r\n: I collected the Bugs as they returned and let out a short sigh.
どうやら一匹として敵の蟲とは遇わなかったらしく、\r\n都会に棲む昆虫なんかをせ: It seemed not a single one had encountered an enemy Bug -- they'd apparently been busily feeding on whatever insects happened to live in the city.
その間、オレはと言えばあの女が現れそうな場所を\r\n歩いたりしてみたのだが成果: As for me, I'd spent the time walking around places where that woman seemed likely to appear, but came up with nothing.
ま、蟲どもが安全に餌を食えただけ良しとするか。\r\n: Well, at least the Bugs got to feed safely. I'd call that good enough.
蟲どもに餌をやるため、オレはよく利用する森へと\r\nやって来た。\r\n: To feed my Bugs, I had come to the forest I often used.
辺りの雰囲気はいつも通りで、これといって変わった\r\n様子はない。\r\n: The atmosphere around me was the same as always -- nothing out of the ordinary.
あの女がここにいる可能性は低そうだと思いながら、\r\nオレは蟲を放ってみること: Thinking it unlikely that woman would be here, I decided to release the Bugs anyway.
オレの命令を受けて、数匹の蟲が森の中に入っていく。\r\n: Following my order, several Bugs disappeared into the forest.
もっとも、敵の蟲に攻撃する許可を与えているだけで、\r\n実際は命令というほどの: Though really, all I'd given them was permission to attack any enemy Bugs they found -- it wasn't much of an order in the true sense...
煉悟\r\n「……ったく、面倒なことになってきやがったぜ」\r\n:
Rengo
"...Damn, this is turning into a real pain in the ass."
近くの樹の幹に寝転んで、頭の上に広がる空を見つめ\r\nる。\r\n: I lay back against a nearby tree trunk and stared up at the sky spreading above my head.
蟲使いの村から逃げ出して何年経ったかは忘れたが、\r\n上手く隠れ続けてきたとい: I'd lost count of how many years it had been since I fled the Bug User village -- I'd managed to stay hidden all that time, and then that bastard Nishi had gone and ruined everything.
あの閉鎖的な一族のことだ。\r\nオレが生きている限り、次々と追っ手を送り込んで: That insular clan was exactly the type. As long as I was alive, they'd keep sending hunters after me, one after another.
この戦いが終わったら、活動する町の拠点を変えたほ\r\nうがいいかもしれない。\: Once this fight was over, it might be better to move my base of operations to a different town.
だが、今の環境は気に入ってるし、何より西の仕事が\r\n貴重な収入源になっている: But I'd grown fond of my current setup, and I couldn't deny that Nishi's work was a valuable source of income.
必要以上に騒ぎを起こさず、気楽に暮らすためには、\r\n今の状態は打って付けなの: To live easy without stirring up more trouble than necessary, my current situation was perfectly suited.
毒づいてまぶたを閉じる。\r\n: I muttered a curse and closed my eyes.
かつては時代の闇に生き、裏の仕事を請負っていた\r\n蟲使いも今では衰退の一途を: Bug Users, who had once lived in the shadows of their era and taken on work from the underworld, were now on a steady path toward decline.
昔ならいざ知らず、現代において蟲を使った仕事など\r\nそうそうあるはずもない。:
Maybe it was different in the old days, but in the modern era, there was hardly any work
to be had that involved Bugs.
結果、連中は森の中でひっそりと暮らし、今に至って\r\nいるのだ。\r\n:
As a result, those people lived quietly in the forest,
right up to the present day.
オレは、そんな生活に嫌気が差し、一族の村を逃げ出\r\nした……。\r\n:
I had grown sick of that kind of life, and so I fled
the clan's village...
思い出そうとすれば、今でもまぶたの裏に映すことが\r\nできる……。\r\n:
If I try to remember, I can still see it
behind my eyelids even now...
薄暗く、冷たい、蟲の巣食う森。\r\n: A dim, cold forest, infested with Bugs.
古びた結界を張り、外の世界から隔絶された空間。\r\n:
A space sealed off from the outside world
behind ancient barrier wards.
普通の人間なら立ち入る事もできないその場所は、\r\n逆に外に出るのも難しい。\:
That place, which ordinary humans could not even enter,
was equally difficult to leave.
蟲使い達の中には、一度も森を出ることなく死んでい\r\nく者もいるくらいだ。\r:
There were even Bug Users who died
without ever once leaving the forest.
――森と共に生き、蟲と共に生きる。\r\n: -- To live with the forest, to live with the Bugs.
外の世界がどれだけ広いのか、そんなことも知らずに、\r\n蟲使い達は森の中で生き:
Not even knowing how vast the outside world was,
the Bug Users continued trying to live on within the forest.
自分達の生き方に疑問さえ抱かず、己の生を全うしよ\r\nうとする。\r\n:
Never questioning their own way of life,
trying to live out their existence to the fullest.
煉悟\r\n「そんなもんに縋るようにして生きて、何になるって\r\n んだか」\:
Rengo
"What's the point of living
 like you're clinging to something like that?"
昔の生活を思い出して、オレは小さく舌打ちした。\r\n: Remembering the life I'd left behind, I clicked my tongue softly.
頭の中を占めるのは、蟲を操る修練ばかりの記憶だけ\r\nで、それ以外に覚えている:
The only memories occupying my mind were of training to control Bugs --
there was nothing else I could recall.
たとえ裏切り者として命を狙われようとも、今の生活\r\nのほうが何倍もマシだった:
Even if it meant being hunted as a traitor,
my current life was a hundred times better.
煉悟\r\n「クヒッ、あの女にもそれを分からせてやるか」\r\n:
Rengo
"Khih -- maybe I'll make that woman understand the same thing."
あの蟲使いの女をとっ捕まえたときの事を想像して、\r\nオレは軽く肩を揺らした。:
Imagining the moment I'd get my hands on that Bug User woman,
I gave a light shake of my shoulders.
耳の奥で、艶かしい嬌声が聞こえた気がした……。\r\n: Deep in my ears, I thought I could hear a seductive moan...
森の中に入って程なく、オレは道なき道を進み川辺へ\r\nとやって来ていた。\r\:
Not long after entering the forest, I had pushed through pathless terrain
and made my way to the riverbank.
辺りからは、鳥の鳴き声やら小動物の気配やらがして、\r\nのどかと言えばのどかだ:
From all around came birdsong and the presence of small animals --
peaceful, you might say.
念のため神経を集中させてみるが、蟲の気配も感じら\r\nれない。\r\n:
I focused my senses as a precaution,
but I couldn't detect any trace of Bugs.
……もっとも、オレは感知が苦手だったから、あまり\r\nアテにならないかもしれな:
Though, since detection was never my strong suit,
I might not be the most reliable judge of that.
煉悟\r\n「オラ、行って来い。\r\n ……んで、他の蟲がいたらぶっ殺しちまえ:
Rengo
"Go on, get out there.
 ...And if you find any other Bugs, kill them."
そんな命令を下しながら、蟲を周囲の森へと解き放つ。\r\n: Issuing that order, I released my Bugs into the surrounding forest.
結果にはあまり期待していないが、オレは木陰に座り\r\n込んで暫く待つことにした:
I wasn't expecting much from the results, but I settled down
in the shade of a tree and decided to wait a while.
俄かに辺りの気配が騒がしくなった。\r\n: All at once, the forest around me came alive with commotion.
遠くから鳥の羽ばたきが聞こえ、同時に鳴き声が響き\r\n渡る。\r\n:
The sound of birds taking flight reached me from a distance,
their cries ringing out at the same time.
ガサガサと風ではない何かで木々が揺れ、黒い影が\r\n矢のような速度で飛び回った:
The trees rustled with something that was not the wind,
and black shadows darted about at arrow-like speed.
衝撃で枝から離れた木の葉が、ひらひらと地面に舞い\r\n落ちる。\r\n:
Leaves shaken loose from branches by the impact
drifted fluttering down to the ground.
